scope: All 19 publicly listed repositories. Repository landing pages, README content when available, and selected supporting source/documents were reviewed. Private repositories are not included.

projects.title: Live Progress
projects.summary: Native live updates for Android 16 and newer.
projects.details: Turns supported progress, media, ride, delivery, and train notifications into live updates across the status bar, lock screen, and always-on display. Preserves original notifications and provides per-category controls.

projects.title: Coursera Downloader
projects.summary: A fork of the coursera-dl course resource downloader.
projects.details: Downloads and organizes accessible Coursera course materials. Forked from coursera-dl/coursera-dl; the upstream project and its authors provide the original implementation.

projects.title: CoWIN Status Tracker GUI
projects.summary: A JavaFX desktop application for vaccination slot updates.
projects.details: Searches by PIN code or district, shows toast notifications when slots are available, and supports downloading vaccination certificates. The README specifies JDK 17 and Gradle.

projects.title: AER Ad Bot
projects.summary: A Python Discord bot for automated messages.
projects.details: Uses the Discord client and asynchronous task loops, with text and image resources for composing messages. The repository includes a Procfile and Python dependency list.

projects.title: Deep RL Recommender
projects.summary: A recommendation system using deep reinforcement learning.
projects.details: A collaborative implementation prepared for the CS F317 Reinforcement Learning course. The implementation is provided as a Jupyter notebook.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.summary: The GitHub Pages repository behind this website.
projects.details: The scanned public repository contains a compiled JavaScript portfolio. This local rebuild replaces that page with a repository-driven portfolio.

projects.title: CoWIN Status Tracker CLI
projects.summary: Vaccination slot tracking from the command line.
projects.details: Searches by district or PIN code with age, dose, and vaccine filters. Polls every 60 seconds, shows desktop notifications, and offers optional SMS alerts through Twilio.

projects.title: Machine Learning Assignments
projects.summary: Machine learning coursework organized into two assignments.
projects.details: Contains Assignment 1 and Assignment 2 directories. The repository has no project README, so specific model claims are intentionally omitted.

projects.title: Deep Learning Assignments
projects.summary: Deep learning coursework, including MNIST detection models.
projects.details: Contains an Assignment 2 directory and an MNIST Detection Models directory. These are learning implementations rather than a deployed application.

projects.title: Data Mining Assignments
projects.summary: Python data mining coursework in two assignment collections.
projects.details: Contains Assignment 1 and Assignment 2 directories. No README is available on the repository landing page.

projects.title: Cryptography Assignments
projects.summary: Python cryptography coursework in two assignment collections.
projects.details: Contains Assignment 1 and Assignment 2 directories. Specific algorithms are not described on the repository landing page.

projects.title: LSH Document Retrieval
projects.summary: Find similar documents with locality-sensitive hashing.
projects.details: Accepts a shingle length, query document ID, and Jaccard similarity threshold, then ranks similar documents from the corpus. The README credits a four-person project team.

projects.title: Movie Recommender Systems
projects.summary: Three approaches to movie recommendations on MovieLens.
projects.details: A collaborative CS F469 project comparing collaborative filtering, singular value decomposition (SVD), and CUR decomposition on the MovieLens dataset. Uses NumPy and Pandas.

projects.title: FODS Assignments
projects.summary: A collection of notebook-based FODS assignments.
projects.details: Organized into A1, A2, and A3 directories. The public description identifies the repository as FODS Assignment.

projects.title: Student Record System
projects.summary: Store and retrieve school student data in a desktop app.
projects.details: A Java Swing application connected to a school database, organized under the StudentRecord directory.

projects.title: Cab Booking Simulator
projects.summary: Simulate booking a cab and following an ongoing ride.
projects.details: A Java Swing desktop simulation of the cab booking process and the ride in progress. The project lives in the CabBooking directory.

projects.title: Normalizer 2
projects.summary: A second Java database normalization project.
projects.details: A separate repository for database normalization using Java. The public repository does not document the differences from Normalizer.

projects.title: Normalizer
projects.summary: A Java utility for relational database normalization.
projects.details: Explores database normalization in Java. Repository topics include database management and normalization.

projects.title: Extendible Hashing
projects.details: A database data-structure simulation, provided in the Extendible Hashing project directory.
